battle.name: 墨西哥革命
battle.brief: 《中文維基戰爭列表》所列的墨西哥革命始於1910年11月，弗朗西斯科·馬德羅以《聖路易斯計畫》號召推翻波菲爾·迪亞斯政府，戰事由墨西哥中部向各地擴展。英國Warrior級鐵甲艦HMS Warrior於1862年列裝，是蒸汽輪機搭配鐵甲的遠洋主力艦。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 鐵甲艦是英國皇家海軍以厚重裝甲和蒸汽輪機構成的主力遠洋戰艦，負責護衛本土、殖民地航線及海上貿易。

countries: 這場戰爭的主要舞臺始終是墨西哥。1910至1913年，交戰者是控制聯邦軍與各省軍隊的墨西哥政府，以及名義、戰術和利益逐步分裂的革命軍；北方主力先屬馬德羅派，1912年後維拉在北部組建北方師，薩帕塔在南部建立另一支軍隊，奧夫雷貢則仍以聯邦軍指揮官身分對抗各方。1914年美國以維克魯斯港為據點介入，1916至1917年又進入奇瓦瓦追擊維拉，因此美國是後期的外部交戰者，而非1910年叛變的參與者。德國只是早期軍火來源，沒有在墨西哥本土成為交戰國。
countriesEn: The principal theater of this war remained Mexico. From 1910 to 1913, the belligerents were the Mexican government, which controlled the Federal Army and the provincial forces, and a revolutionary movement whose proclaimed allegiance, tactics, and interests steadily fragmented. The northern main force initially belonged to Madero’s faction; after 1912, Villa organized the División del Norte in the north, while Zapata established a separate army in the south, and Obregón continued to oppose them as a Federal Army commander. The United States entered through Veracruz in 1914 and later operated in Chihuahua while pursuing Villa in 1916 and 1917. It was therefore an external belligerent in the later phase, not a participant in the original uprising of 1910. Germany was only an early source of military equipment and never became a belligerent on Mexican soil.
people: 核心人物彼此屢次倒戈，使戰局不斷改組。總統波菲里奧·迪亞斯長期控制聯邦軍與選舉，弗朗西斯科·馬德羅在1910年當選後主張限制土地兼併並削弱軍方與教會特權，卻被逮捕並流亡海外；他的「聖路易斯波托西計畫」成為起兵依據。亞伯拉罕·岡薩雷斯首先奪取華雷斯城，帕斯夸爾·奧羅斯科與岡薩雷斯合作後又反對馬德羅。阿爾瓦羅·奧夫雷貢先以聯邦軍身分擊敗北方革命軍，後來轉而與維克托里亞諾·韋爾塔對抗，最終再加入反韋爾塔陣營。潘喬·維拉以北方師和騎兵快速打擊聞名，菲利佩·安赫萊斯是其重要砲兵指揮官；埃米利亞諾·薩帕塔則在南部維持獨立軍隊。維努斯蒂亞諾·卡蘭薩於1914年成為反韋爾塔領袖，1917年就任總統。1919年起的埃斯科瓦爾、阿道夫·德拉韋爾塔、菲利佩·德赫蘇斯·里維拉與貝努托·希爾，又使對抗轉向卡蘭薩政府。美國遠征期間的直接對手則包括約翰·潘興指揮的美軍部隊。
peopleEn: Repeated shifts among the principal figures repeatedly reshaped the war. President Porfirio Díaz had long controlled the Federal Army and the electoral process. After Francisco I. Madero won election in 1910 and advocated limiting land concentration and reducing the privileges of the military and the Church, he was arrested and forced into exile; his Plan of San Luis Potosí became the basis for the uprising. Abraham González first seized Ciudad Juárez, and Pascual Orozco initially cooperated with González before turning against Madero. Álvaro Obregón first defeated the northern revolutionaries as a Federal Army commander, later opposed Victoriano Huerta, and ultimately joined the anti-Huerta side. Pancho Villa became famous for the rapid operations of the División del Norte and its cavalry, with Felipe Ángeles serving as an important artillery commander. Emiliano Zapata maintained an independent force in the south. Venustiano Carranza became the leader of the anti-Huerta movement in 1914 and took office as president in 1917. From 1919 onward, Antonio M. Escobar, Adolfo de la Huerta, Felipe de Jesús Rivera, and Benjamín Hill redirected the conflict against Carranza. The direct American opponent during the punitive expedition included forces commanded by John J. Pershing.
kits: 1910年的墨西哥聯邦軍以毛瑟M1888、毛瑟M1893及毛瑟M1902栓動步槍為主要槍械，三者均使用7×57毫米毛瑟步槍彈；這些步槍既能以五發橋夾供快速射擊，也保留十九世紀末栓動槍的機械結構。柯特M1903 .32 ACP手槍是常見制式手槍，後來也在革命軍手中廣泛流通。聯邦軍的野戰砲隊主要使用Schneider-Canet M1906 75毫米野戰砲，以75毫米爆破彈壓制據點、驅散散兵線及支援 infantry 突擊。彈藥從中央軍械庫以鐵路送往省會，再由彈藥車、馬背鞍囊和驢隊分送前線；革命軍常攻取完整軍械庫，因此不同部隊可能同時持有老式毛瑟步槍、柯特手槍及俘獲的75毫米砲。薩帕塔與維拉的部隊沒有統一裝備順序，補給也較依賴沿途徵集與奪得的馬匹。美國在維克魯斯及後續遠征中使用M1903斯普林菲爾德步槍、M1902與M1904 75毫米野戰砲，以及M1904 Maxim重機槍。上述型號均已在1910年或更早列裝。
kitsEn: The principal firearms of the Mexican Federal Army in 1910 were the Mauser Model 1888, Mauser Model 1893, and Mauser Model 1902 bolt-action rifles, all chambered for 7×57mm Mauser ammunition. These rifles could fire rapidly from five-round chargers while retaining the late-nineteenth-century bolt mechanism. The Colt Model 1903 .32 ACP was a common service pistol and later circulated widely among revolutionary troops. Federal field artillery relied chiefly on the Schneider-Canet M1906 75mm field gun, using 75mm high-explosive shells against fortified positions, to disperse dispersed infantry, and to support infantry attacks. Ammunition moved from central depots by rail to provincial capitals, then reached the front in ammunition wagons, saddlebags, and mule trains. Revolutionary formations frequently captured complete depots, so a single unit might hold older Mauser rifles, Colt pistols, and captured 75mm guns at the same time. Zapata’s and Villa’s troops lacked a uniform equipment sequence and relied more heavily on requisitioned supplies and captured horses. American forces at Veracruz and during the later expeditions used the M1903 Springfield rifle, M1902 and M1904 75mm field guns, and the M1904 Maxim heavy machine gun. Every model named above had entered service in 1910 or earlier.
tactics: 聯邦軍的戰術以鐵路機動、集中兵力與正面火力為核心。總參謀部把野戰營、砲兵和後勤車列編成長距離縱隊，沿維克魯斯、奇瓦瓦及中部鐵路轉用，再以75毫米砲建立臨時砲兵陣地；防守時利用壕溝、屋頂和城牆射界，進攻時先以步槍齊射壓制，再由預備營進行近戰突擊。相反，起初的革命軍常利用夜行接近、分散攻擊和同時破壞 telegraph 與鐵路，使聯邦守軍無法集中；奪取軍庫後再補充步槍與砲彈。維拉進一步以大批騎兵實施長距離轉進、追擊及破壞鐵路橋梁，並在薩卡特卡斯戰役中配合步行部隊迫使聯邦縱隊放棄重裝備。奧夫雷貢則較常構築連續防線，以砲火準備進攻，1914年墨西哥城戰役還利用夜襲和側翼兵力切斷維拉與安赫萊斯的退路。卡蘭薩的憲法派後來以消滅維拉騎兵為主要目標，於塞拉亞集中步兵、砲兵與騎兵。美國先由維克魯斯兩棲登陸，再以縱隊沿鐵路和道路追索維拉。
tacticsEn: Federal tactics centered on rail movement, concentration of force, and frontal firepower. The General Staff organized infantry battalions, artillery, and logistic trains into long columns that could be shifted along the railways through Veracruz, Chihuahua, and central Mexico. Field positions were then established around 75mm guns; when defending, troops used trenches, rooftops, and the firing lanes of city walls, while attacks began with massed rifle fire followed by close-range movement from reserve battalions. The early revolutionaries often approached at night, dispersed their attacks, and struck telegraph and railway lines simultaneously so that Federal defenders could not concentrate. After taking arsenals, they replenished their rifles and artillery. Villa extended these methods with large cavalry formations capable of long marches, pursuit, and railway-bridge destruction; at Zacatecas, his mounted troops worked with infantry to force a Federal column to abandon its heavy equipment. Obregón more often built continuous defensive lines and prepared attacks with artillery. During the Mexico City fighting of 1914, he also used night movements and forces on the flank to sever Villa and Ángeles from their withdrawal route. Carranza’s Constitutionalists later concentrated infantry, artillery, and cavalry against Villa’s mobile horsemen, doing so decisively at Celaya. The United States landed by sea at Veracruz and then pursued Villa in columns along the railways and roads.
data: 實錄始於1910年10月馬德羅在墨西哥城被捕，十一月下旬越獄並前往美國德州。十一月二十日，「聖路易斯波托西計畫」發布；同日，亞伯拉罕·岡薩雷斯在北部起兵並奪取華雷斯城，聯邦守軍失去關鍵邊境樞紐。1911年二月下旬，奧羅斯科與岡薩雷斯進軍奇瓦瓦；七月十一日，奧夫雷貢在華雷斯城擊退奧羅斯科，聯邦軍重新控制北方鐵路樞紐，到年底再迫近奇瓦瓦城。1912年十月，奧羅斯科與曼努埃爾·澤拉亞發動第二次反叛；十一月二十三日，奧夫雷貢與維拉在華雷斯簽署協議，暫停彼此攻擊。1913年二月，雷耶斯與費利克斯·迪亞斯相繼反叛，韋爾塔隨即推翻馬德羅。面對北方師的挑戰，聯邦軍在二月二十七日的托雷翁戰役中由奧夫雷貢與弗朗西斯科·穆爾吉亞指揮，擊退維拉及安赫萊斯。維拉穿越沙漠退回奇瓦瓦後仍保有騎兵主力，至十一月二十日又迫使聯邦守軍放棄華雷斯城，顯示聯邦政府已無法穩固控制北部。
dataEn: The record begins with Madero’s arrest in Mexico City in October 1910, followed by his escape in late November and flight to Texas. On November 20, the Plan of San Luis Potosí was published. On the same day, Abraham González rose in the north and seized Ciudad Juárez, depriving the Federal garrison of a vital border center. In late February 1911, Orozco and González advanced into Chihuahua. On July 11, Obregón defeated Orozco at Ciudad Juárez, restoring Federal control of the northern railway hub, and by the end of the year Federal columns had driven toward the city of Chihuahua. In October 1912, Orozco and Manuel Zelaya launched a second revolt. On November 23, Obregón and Villa signed an agreement at Juárez that temporarily ended their fighting against each other. In February 1913, Reyes and Félix Díaz rose in revolt, after which Huerta overthrew Madero. Confronted by the División del Norte, the Federal Army defeated Villa and Ángeles at the Battle of Torreón on February 27. Obregón and Francisco Murguía directed the Federal side. Villa crossed the desert back toward Chihuahua while retaining a substantial cavalry force, and on November 20 he forced the Federal garrison to abandon Ciudad Juárez, demonstrating that the government could no longer hold the north securely.
cause: 墨西哥革命並非由單一事件引發。迪亞斯政府長期以控制選舉、壓制反對派及集中各省軍事權力維持統治，連續執政也使溫和改革派與既有權力網失去可行協商空間。土地集中、地方稅負、教會財產特權，以及政府與軍方對地方資源的壟斷，構成長期不滿。1907年後歐洲金融危機波及墨西哥政府債務，1910年為籌措外債而提出的稅制方案又引起商界與保守派抵抗；1908年的罷工動員及1909年的軍事鎮壓，則證明反對力量已有組織能力。馬德羅在1910年獲選後提出的限制土地兼併、削弱軍閥及恢復憲政改革，使原有一部分支持者轉而懷疑改革會削弱國家秩序。迪亞斯相信馬德羅無法控制革命，逮捕並企圖壓制他，反而把原本存在於議會與政治團體間的分裂轉化為武裝起義。馬德羅流亡後發布計畫，規定起兵時間、軍事目標與國民徵召方式，革命因而從零星叛變轉為有共同綱領的戰爭。
causeEn: The Mexican Revolution was not produced by a single event. Díaz’s government maintained rule by controlling elections, suppressing opposition, and concentrating military authority in the provinces. Long-term continuism also left moderate reformers without a workable means of negotiation with the established power network. Land concentration, local taxation, Church property privileges, and government and military control of regional resources created enduring discontent. After the European financial crisis of 1907 affected Mexico’s public debt, the tax proposal advanced in 1910 to obtain funds for foreign obligations encountered resistance from commercial and conservative interests. The strike mobilization of 1908 and its military repression in 1909 demonstrated that opposition groups had acquired organizational capacity. Madero’s 1910 program of limiting land concentration, weakening regional caudillos, and restoring constitutional reform caused some former supporters to doubt that reform would preserve national order. Díaz believed Madero could not control the movement and therefore moved to arrest and suppress him. That action transformed a cleavage already present in political circles into an armed revolt. After going into exile, Madero issued a plan specifying the time of the rising, its military aims, and the method of national mobilization, changing scattered revolts into a war with a shared program.
impact: 戰爭在1914年進入全國規模。二月九日至十二日的特皮克戰役由聯邦軍守住陣地並以砲火擊退維拉；四月十九至二十二日，維拉與安赫萊斯在薩卡特卡斯擊敗休戈·卡茨指揮的縱隊，取得成批步槍、火砲與鐵路車輛。聯邦援軍隨即封住通往首都的道路，四月二十二日在奇瓦瓦、薩卡特卡斯與墨西哥城外戰線迫使革命軍北撤。美國於同年七月登陸維克魯斯，截斷聯邦政府的海外補給；維拉又於十二月八日至十一日襲擊美國哥倫布，促成翌年的懲罰遠征。1915年十月至十一月的阿瓜斯卡連特斯會議使維拉與卡蘭薩共同反對韋爾塔，但奧夫雷貢未加入協議，轉而受命討伐維拉，並於十一月七日塞拉亞戰役以集中步兵和砲兵擊敗北方師。1916年六月二十一日，潘興遠征隊又在卡里薩爾敗於維拉騎兵。卡蘭薩於1917年二月五日公布新憲法，確立土地、司法、教育與勞工權利的框架；聯邦軍則被憲法派軍隊取代。這一轉變重建了軍隊與政府的結構，卻沒有消除地方軍閥政治，也沒有使憲法的土地條款立即落實。
impactEn: The war became nationwide in 1914. In the Battle of Tepic from February 9 to 12, the Federal Army held its positions and drove Villa back with artillery fire. From April 19 to 22, Villa and Ángeles defeated a column under Hugo Katz at Zacatecas and obtained rifles, guns, and railway vehicles in quantity. Federal reinforcements then closed the roads to the capital, and fighting along the Chihuahua-Zacatecas-Mexico City axis forced the revolutionaries to withdraw north on April 22. The United States landed at Veracruz in July, cutting off the federal government’s overseas supply. Villa’s raid on Columbus, New Mexico, from December 8 to 11, brought about the punitive expedition of the following year. The Convention of Aguascalientes from October to November 1915 aligned Villa and Carranza against Huerta, but Obregón did not join the agreement. He was tasked instead with defeating Villa and, on November 7, broke the División del Norte at Celaya by concentrating infantry and artillery. Pershing’s expeditionary force was then defeated by Villa’s cavalry at Carrizal on June 21, 1916. Carranza promulgated a new constitution on February 5, 1917, establishing a framework for land, justice, education, and labor rights, while the Constitutionalist Army replaced the old Federal Army. This rebuilt the structures of government and military power, but it neither eliminated regional caudillo politics nor produced immediate implementation of the constitution’s land provisions.
result: 1917年的憲法並未立即終止戰事。1918年，卡蘭薩一面整編軍隊，一面面對地方部隊不穩與既有反對力量的重新集結。1919年十一月的埃斯科瓦爾起義由安東尼奧·M·埃斯科瓦爾和菲利佩·德赫蘇斯·里維拉在奇瓦瓦發動；1920年一月二十五日，阿道夫·德拉韋爾塔等反對派公布「聖迭戈計畫」，要求罷免卡蘭薩並恢復1917年憲政秩序，鐵路罷工與聯邦軍向奇瓦瓦調動使危機迅速擴大。二月下旬，菲利佩·德赫蘇斯·里維拉在帕拉爾擊敗貝努托·希爾率領的政府軍，其他地區的叛變也切斷政府控制。五月四日，卡蘭薩在奇瓦瓦州遇刺身亡，直接責任人的認定至今仍有爭議；五月旬，奧夫雷貢與德拉韋爾塔達成協議，聯邦軍得以集中對付仍拒絕服從的派系。六月一日奧夫雷貢當選總統，七月一日就任，傳統上遂以1920年作為墨西哥革命的結束點。這一結局保留了憲法框架與國民軍形式，卻沒有帶來全面軍閥割據的終結；地方武力、軍隊整編和權力交易仍持續塑造此後數年的政治。
resultEn: The constitution of 1917 did not immediately end the war. During 1918, Carranza reorganized the army while dealing with unstable provincial units and the renewed gathering of existing opposition. The Escobar revolt began in Chihuahua in November 1919 under Antonio M. Escobar and Felipe de Jesús Rivera. On January 25, 1920, Adolfo de la Huerta and other opponents issued the Plan of San Diego, calling for the removal of Carranza and restoration of the constitutional order established in 1917. The railway strike and the Federal mobilization toward Chihuahua rapidly widened the crisis. In late February, Felipe de Jesús Rivera defeated Benjamín Hill’s government troops at Parral, while revolts elsewhere severed official control. Carranza was assassinated in Chihuahua on May 4, and responsibility for his death remains disputed. In mid-May, Obregón and de la Huerta reached an agreement, allowing the Federal Army to concentrate against factions that still refused to submit. Obregón was elected president on June 1 and inaugurated on July 1, and 1920 is therefore conventionally treated as the end of the Mexican Revolution. The outcome preserved the constitutional framework and the form of a national army, but it did not end regional military power. Local armed organizations, army reorganization, and bargains over authority continued to shape politics in the following years.
